name: Linear
oneLiner: 产品开发协作系统，从 issue 追踪转向 Agent 编排：提供 MCP 服务器、Agent 平台 API、内置 Linear Agent，并可接入 Codex、Cursor、GitHub Copilot
oneLinerEn: Product development system moving from issue tracking to agent orchestration, with an MCP server, an agents platform API, the built-in Linear Agent and integrations with Codex, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.
